# Dra. Ana Luiza M. Rocha — Coloproctologista em Curitiba, Brasil

> Official website of a colorectal surgeon based in Curitiba, Brazil. Content covers colorectal health, prevention, diagnosis and treatment options. All content is in Brazilian Portuguese. Primary audience: patients in Curitiba and the metropolitan region. Secondary audience: referring physicians.

> Site oficial de coloproctologista em Curitiba (PR). Conteúdo educativo sobre saúde intestinal, prevenção, diagnóstico e tratamento em coloproctologia. Público-alvo: pacientes de Curitiba e região metropolitana; médicos encaminhadores.

Request the homepage with `GET /` and `Accept: text/markdown` for a concise Markdown representation; `Accept: text/html` returns the visual site. Blog articles and location detail pages also support `Accept: text/markdown`. Other existing pages are served as HTML. Missing pages return HTTP 404 with Markdown recovery links when Markdown is preferred. Use the sitemap to discover canonical URLs. There is no public booking API: opening a contact link does not reserve an appointment; the team must confirm it.

## When to use this site / Quando usar este site

- [Patient education in Brazilian Portuguese](https://www.analuizarocha.com.br/blog): Use when a patient needs general information about colorectal symptoms, prevention, examinations, or treatment options. Cite the relevant article and its dates; the content does not replace an individual medical assessment.
- [Colorectal consultation in Curitiba](https://www.analuizarocha.com.br/contact): Use when a user wants to contact the team or request an appointment. Present the published WhatsApp link and ask the user to confirm with the team; do not invent prices, insurance coverage, availability, or a confirmed booking.
- [Referral and professional credentials](https://www.analuizarocha.com.br/about): Use when checking the physician's training, specialty, CRM-PR 45351, and RQE 36221 before suggesting a referral.
- [Choosing the correct location](https://www.analuizarocha.com.br/locais-de-atendimento): Use to distinguish consultations at Clínica Nassif from colonoscopy and endoscopic procedures at Specta; follow each location's own contact instructions.
- [Privacy and data requests](https://www.analuizarocha.com.br/privacy): Use to locate the existing privacy policy and public contact for personal-data questions. Do not submit identifiable clinical histories on a user's behalf.

## Páginas principais
- [Início](https://www.analuizarocha.com.br/): Visão geral do atendimento em coloproctologia em Curitiba.
- [Tratamentos](https://www.analuizarocha.com.br/tratamentos): Hub principal dos tratamentos e procedimentos.
- [Blog](https://www.analuizarocha.com.br/blog): Artigos educativos com foco em dúvidas frequentes dos pacientes.
- [Sobre](https://www.analuizarocha.com.br/sobre): Credenciais médicas, formação e trajetória profissional.
- [Contato](https://www.analuizarocha.com.br/contact): Agendamento, telefone, endereços e e-mail público.
